requirements.statement: FS0 Governance SHALL implement Design Proposal -> Design -> Plan -> Build -> accepted repository state.
Design SHALL use Audit, Normalize, Accept; Plan SHALL use Analyze, Specify, Accept; Build SHALL use Implement, Verify, Accept.

Each governed Design, Plan, and Build work item SHALL record stable identity, predecessor, scope, material exclusions where applicable, candidate result, completion conditions, disposition, provenance, and bounded authorization.
Design SHALL consume a non-authoritative Design Proposal.
Plan SHALL consume accepted Design authority and define realization intent covering affected artifacts, Conformance work, Assurance work, dependencies, sequencing, and bounded Build scope.
Build SHALL consume an accepted Plan and implement only work authorized by that Plan.
Semantic defects SHALL route to Design, realization-intent defects to Plan, and implementation defects to Build.
Governance acceptance SHALL be explicit, attributable, traceable, and candidate-specific.
A Governance acceptance decision SHALL depend only on authority accepted before the candidate acquires authority produced by that acceptance.
A governed work item SHALL authorize only its explicit scope.
For the FS0 GitHub binding, each Design, Plan, or Build acceptance record SHALL be a structured machine-readable GitHub issue comment on that stage's governed-work issue.
Every machine-readable acceptance comment SHALL use marker repo-spec-acceptance:v1 followed immediately by exactly one fenced JSON object containing the Governance-defined acceptance envelope.

A governance-acceptance record SHALL contain schema_version, record_type, stage, acceptance_id, work_id, candidate_id, disposition, actor, evidence, decision_timestamp; an accepted Build SHALL also contain resulting_accepted_state equal to candidate_id, otherwise it SHALL be absent.

A bootstrap-acceptance record SHALL use the Governance acceptance envelope with stage bootstrap; evidence SHALL identify bootstrap verification and semantic-audit results; accepted records SHALL set resulting_accepted_state equal to candidate_id.
For repository-changing work, candidate_id SHALL resolve to an exact Git commit SHA.
Accepted repository state SHALL be represented by refs/heads/accepted plus a matching valid acceptance record.
Default-branch position, merge state, pull-request state, review state, comment state, and workflow state SHALL NOT independently create accepted repository state.
Initial bootstrap acceptance SHALL be recorded on a dedicated external bootstrap provenance issue that machine-resolvably identifies the actor authorized to make the bootstrap acceptance decision.

For Design, Plan, or Build acceptance, actor SHALL match an identity explicitly named by that governed work item's bounded authorization; bootstrap actor SHALL match the decision authority identified by the bootstrap provenance issue.
After FS0 cutover, every persistent framework change SHALL occur through FS0 Governance.
